ideas.title: Build a Battle Barge ⚓
ideas.hook: Build your own floating warship block by block in the harbour, then sail it into a shared sea arena and blast other players' barges apart.
core_loop: Collect scrap and coins from the harbour
Bolt hull blocks, cannons and armour onto your barge
Sail into the arena and shoot enemy barges
Sink ships for salvage and medals
Unlock bigger hulls and heavier guns
ideas.twist: Every block you add makes the barge sit lower in the water, so heavy guns can sink you before the enemy does.
monetization: VIP harbour slip with an extra build slot
retention: Blueprint saving for your best builds
ideas.why_now: Fight / battle + Shooter is one of the top new-game pairs (8 new games, 80,186 CCU). Military / war is at 1.76 (up 0.18 this week) led by Voxel Wars (18,247), the "Build a ___" formula is at 1.44 with Build Your World! (20,008), and Arena maps are at 1.46.
ideas.differentiator: Building and fighting are one loop: your design is your loadout, and the waterline turns every extra gun into a real trade-off.

ideas.title: Paint Runes for Light 🕯️
ideas.hook: The lights in an old house are dying. You survive the night by painting glowing runes on walls and floors, and the thing in the dark cannot cross them.
core_loop: Collect glow paint from rooms while the lights still work
Paint a rune by tracing its shape on a wall or floor
Hide behind your runes when the monster hunts
Find rune pages to unlock stronger shapes
Survive until dawn to finish the chapter
ideas.twist: Sloppy runes glow weaker and fade faster, so drawing well under pressure is the skill that keeps you alive.
retention: New story chapter on each update
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.56 (33 new games) and Paint + Horror is the third-biggest gap in the data (score 4.43). Horror jumped to 1.29 (up 0.66 this week) with Suzy Says! [HORROR] (18,648), Interiors are the fastest-rising map style at 1.86 (NIGHT WITH OPAH 23,606) and Story is at 1.80.
ideas.differentiator: Horror games hand you a flashlight; here your own drawing is the only defence, so every night plays out differently.

ideas.title: Reel Bots for Parts 🤖
ideas.hook: Fish in a polluted robot sea. Every catch is a broken bot part, and when you have a full set you assemble a robot that fishes for you.
core_loop: Cast into the scrap sea
Reel in heads, arms, legs and cores
Log each part in the index
Assemble full robots on your dock
Robots auto-fish and unlock deeper waters
ideas.twist: Parts come with mutations (rusty, chrome, haunted), and mixing them changes what your robot can catch.
ideas.why_now: Fishing climbed to 1.35 (up 0.55 this week) with [🐟] Fish For Sea Animals (20,695) and Cast For Fish! (14,043). Collect + Fishing is the biggest pair by new games (17 games, 77,410 CCU), Fishing + Robots is an open gap (score 3.07) and Robots / mechs sits at 1.80.
ideas.differentiator: The catches are build pieces, so the index turns into a robot crew that changes how you fish.

ideas.title: Roll Dice for Castles 🏰
ideas.hook: A board-game siege. Roll dice to march your knights around a ring of tiles, recruit troops on the way and storm the castle in the middle.
core_loop: Roll the dice and move along the board
Land on tiles to recruit knights, archers or dragons
Pass the gate to attack the castle with your army
Capture castles to earn gold while offline
Unlock bigger boards and lucky dice
ideas.twist: Other players' captured castles sit on your board; land next to one and you can raid it.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards is at 1.25 with 12 new games, led by My Little Pony Card Opening (8,776). Fantasy / medieval rose to 1.37 (up 0.34 this week) with [⚔️] Kit PVP FFA (9,217) and Dragon Arena (7,044), and Dice + Fantasy is an open gap (score 2.82).
ideas.differentiator: Dice games are usually pure luck; here the board path and nearby raids make every roll a small decision.

ideas.title: Whack Karts for Crowns 🏁
ideas.hook: Half the server races karts around a track. The other half stands on the sidelines with giant bats and swings to knock them off. Then you swap.
core_loop: Join a round as a racer or a hitter
Racers dodge and drift to the finish
Hitters time swings to launch karts off the track
Earn crowns for finishes and knockouts
Spend crowns on bats, karts and launch effects
ideas.twist: A launched kart that lands back on the track counts as a shortcut, so skilled racers can use the hitters against them.
monetization: Luck pass for golden bat drops
retention: Kart and bat mutations to collect
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is at 1.91 with 60 new games and 240,050 CCU, led by Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (49,140). Hit + Race / drive is the second-biggest pair in new games (10 games, 81,160 CCU), and Physics Sim is the top-rising subgenre at 2.64 (BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 20,678).
ideas.differentiator: Racing and launching are two roles in the same round, so you get crash physics with a reason to play both sides.

ideas.title: Bulldoze Bunkers for Medals 🪖
ideas.hook: Drive an armoured bulldozer through a war zone, smashing bunkers, walls and barricades to clear a road before the convoy arrives.
core_loop: Pick a bulldozer and a front-line route
Smash through barricades and bunkers
Collect scrap and medals from the rubble
Race the timer before the convoy reaches you
Upgrade blade, armour and engine
ideas.twist: Some bunkers hold supply crates that give a blade boost, so the fastest route is not always the straight one.
retention: Garage base that shows off your dozers
ideas.why_now: Break + Race / drive is a strong new-game pair (8 games, 66,159 CCU), Military / war is at 1.76 (up 0.18) with Voxel Wars (18,247), Vehicle Sim is at 1.57 with BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (20,678), and Realistic art is rising at 1.42. Break / mine / dig is still above 1 at 1.48, though down 0.46 this week.
inspired_by: Can You Pass A Driving Test?
ideas.differentiator: Destruction is the race: every wall you break is time saved, so the vehicle sim has a clear goal and a clock.

ideas.title: Golf for Alien Pets 🛸
ideas.hook: Swing a golf club to launch a capture pod across a line of planets. Wherever it lands, it catches the alien that lives there.
core_loop: Swing to launch your pod
Land on a planet to catch its alien
Aliens earn cash every second on your pad
Buy stronger clubs to reach farther planets
Fill the alien index
ideas.twist: Landing exactly on a planet's crater gives a mutated alien, so aim matters as much as power.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is rising at 1.91 led by Throw a Seed (36,729) and [🏹] Shoot Arrows For Animals! (22,937), Collect / index is up 0.44 this week to 1.35, and Collect + Hit is the biggest pair (8 new games, 91,648 CCU). Space is at 2.42 (low confidence, mostly Hyper Realistic Ragdoll), with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 (4,465); the "___ for ___" formula is up to 1.87.
ideas.differentiator: A launch game where aim, not just power, decides the rarity, and the target worlds are planets rather than ground tiers.

ideas.title: +1 Sandbag Per Step 🌊
ideas.hook: Every step adds a sandbag to your stack. Run back and drop them on your wall before the next flood wave hits the town.
core_loop: Walk to gain +1 sandbag per step
Carry the stack to your wall and drop it
Survive the flood wave every few minutes
Earn cash for each wave your wall holds
Rebirth for faster stacking and bigger waves
ideas.twist: Each wave is taller than the last and shown on a warning board, so you choose between building now or walking longer for a bigger stack.
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" formula is at 1.58 with 34 new games and +1 stat per action is at 1.55 ([🧬] +1 Venom Evolution 8,236). Disaster / weather is at 2.30 (low confidence, mostly Hyper Realistic Ragdoll) with Stop The Tsunami! (8,257), and DONT SPLASH (12,554) leads the Runner subgenre at 1.36.
ideas.differentiator: The +1 stat is something you physically spend, so every wave forces a choice between growing and defending.

ideas.title: Build a Lander 🌕
ideas.hook: Build a moon lander from parts in your hangar, launch it, then try to land softly on the moon while physics does its best to wreck you.
core_loop: Build a lander from legs, thrusters, fuel tanks and cockpits
Launch and steer the descent
Land as softly as you can for cash
Watch crash replays when it goes wrong
Unlock new parts and harder landing zones
ideas.twist: Every part you lose in a crash stays on the moon as wreckage other players can salvage.
monetization: VIP hangar with more build space
retention: New moons and landing zones each update
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim is the top-rising subgenre at 2.64 and Sandbox is at 2.03 (Build Your World! 🔨 20,008). Space is at 2.42 (low confidence), Vehicle Sim is at 1.57 with Realistic Plane Crashing [UPD 2.5] (6,003), Paint / create (build) is at 1.56 and Low poly art at 1.64.
ideas.differentiator: Crash-physics games are usually pure destruction; here the goal is a clean landing, so crashing is the funny failure, not the point.

ideas.title: Grow Bait for Monster Fish 🪱
ideas.hook: Farm worms, bugs and glowing grubs on your plot, then use them as bait. The weirder the bait you grow, the bigger the monster fish that bites.
core_loop: Plant bait seeds on your plot
Water and harvest bait as it grows
Cast with your bait at the dock
Catch fish and log them in the index
Sell fish to buy rarer bait seeds
ideas.twist: Bait can mutate while growing (glowing, giant, golden), and each mutation pulls in a different monster fish.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is the top-rising mechanic at 2.01 (up 0.29 this week, 55 new games, 129,280 CCU) led by Throw a Seed (36,729) and [🐜] Ant Evolution (14,014). Fishing is up 0.55 to 1.35 with Fish for Secret Animals! (15,835), Collect + Fishing is the biggest pair by new-game count (17 games, 77,410 CCU) and the "___ for ___" formula is at 1.87.
ideas.differentiator: Farming feeds the fishing: your plot decides what you can catch, which gives the grow loop a second payoff.
